description: folklore will always feel like I opened a window and let the air in during the strangest summer. I wrote this when the world went quiet, and I'd sit with my cats and just... dream up these characters. cardigan, august, my tears ricochet — it all poured out so fast I barely touched the piano keys twice. This album means so much to me because it's the first time I let the story be bigger than me 🫶🖤
